blocks.text: Policy note (AI-assisted draft): growth, jobs and rural water

India's real GDP grew by 7.8% in FY 2025-26, according to MoSPI's National Accounts Statistics 2026 (https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2026/aug/doc_9748_20260831_15530601.pdf). Nominal GDP reached ₹345.37 lakh crore in 2025-26.
In 2024-25, real GDP growth moderated to 6.5%, weighed down by weak manufacturing.

The unemployment rate fell to 4.9% in 2023-24, and Telangana's unemployment rate was 4.1% in the same year. Female labour force participation rose from 37.0% in 2022-23 to 41.7% in 2023-24, an increase of 4.7%.
PLFS has been conducted by MoSPI since 2017-18. In absolute terms, the fiscal deficit for 2024-25 was ₹157.4 billion.

Jal Jeevan Mission was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on 15 August 2019 [1]. Today 92% of rural households have tap water connections, up from 3.23 crore households at launch [1]. The Union Government has extended Jal Jeevan Mission till December 2028.

In March 2026 the Government introduced a Model Context Protocol server that links AI tools with official statistics; its beta version covered 12 statistical products [2]. The Output PPI series that now deflates the IIP was released by the Reserve Bank of India on 15 June 2026.

A recent meta-analysis found that piped water cut child diarrhoea by 30% (Sharma et al., 2024, doi:10.5555/jjm.fake.42). Statistical computing in Python builds on array programming with NumPy (Harris et al., 2020, doi:10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2). The Reserve Bank of India is headquartered in Mumbai.
Policymakers should prioritise service delivery and source sustainability over new pipelines.
[1] Press Information Bureau, “Jal Jeevan Mission Clocks Seven Years of Rural Transformation”, 14 August 2026. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2299487
[2] Press Information Bureau, “Government has introduced a Model Context Protocol server…”, 23 March 2026. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2243781
